card.name: Duration wording before anticoagulant treatment
card.fires_on: Small linking words and modifiers (of, with, a, standard, long-term) that sit just before the word anticoagulant or therapy in dosing text for DVT/PE blood-clot treatment, mostly about how long treatment lasts.
